description: Proof-of-concept GB-filtration + jet-order tracker for the Iwahori-Hecke algebra H_n(q).  Provides the data model that the joint-tower SDP confinement solver will need: every reduction step records (filtration grade, jet-order index, Coxeter relation fired).  Verified on σ_1^3 (electron) and (σ_1 σ_2^{-1})^3 (proton/neutron body).

symbolic_q_form.note: Per-grade Hecke-NF coefficients in q for the smallest non-trivial test case (σ_1^3 in H_2).  Each coefficient is a Laurent polynomial in q ∈ ℚ(q); the full reducer produces analogous polynomials for every test case above (see `filtration_certificate` of each entry in `test_cases`).  Numerical specialisation at q = q_0 is downstream and does not appear in this witness.

framework.filtration: Coxeter length ℓ on S_n; degree of T_w = ℓ(w)
framework.gb_nf_rule: T_w · T_i = T_{ws_i} (ascending: ℓ(ws_i) > ℓ(w)) or = (q - q^{-1}) T_w + T_{ws_i} (descending: Hecke fires)
framework.jet_order_definition: ordered sequence of reduction events; each event is a tuple (step, T_i, w_before, w_after, ℓ_before, ℓ_after, relation_fired ∈ {ascending, hecke-quadratic}); jet-order index = step number
framework.precision: exact symbolic in q via SymPy (rational functions of q)

test_cases.name: ascending σ_1 σ_2 σ_3 σ_1 σ_2 σ_1 in H_4 (longest)
ascending σ_1 σ_2 σ_3 σ_4 in H_5
²H disjoint mock (σ_1σ_2^{-1})^3 ⊗ σ_3..σ_5 in H_6
ascending σ_1 σ_2 σ_1 in H_3 (longest element)

summary.next_step: Extend reducer to H_18 (⁶Li) and H_21 (⁷Li); integrate filtration + jet-order constraints into the joint-tower SDP confinement solver to obtain canonical T_w per atom.
